licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (si Signor without an accent, anch' io, brindis).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 20–24, bars 1–76 of No. 3
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (two errors found and corrected, then clean). The German singing translation is left out. Guglielmo's two eighths in bar 1 (re-mo?) close the previous recitative and are kept where they are printed; the voices stop at bar 63 and the piano ends the number alone. Playback tempo ♩ = 128, from the lengths of five recordings (Böhm, Gardiner, Jacobs, Marriner, Cantelli; median 2:22); Mozart gives the word Allegro only.
